The Windsor is an Arketipo sofa with diamond quilting across the padding, each point pinned by a buried button. Made in Italy.

UPHOLSTERY

  • Fabric, category E.
  • Pelle A, Pelle B and Pelle Leonardo.
  • Vellù velvet, eight options.

HOW TO CHOOSE

Every version of this Italian sofa carries the same buttoned quilting, so the decision comes down to the cover. Velvet gives the padding a silky look; the range also includes an extra-large Windsor. Compare it with other living room sofas.
fichas.descripcion_original: The Windsor Italian luxury designer sofa fits in with all kinds of furnitures: perfect in a Traditional setting, in a Contemporary setting it stands out like a valuable work of art. This Italian sofa with high-end tufted upholstery, has a decidedly distinctive feel. It is refined, luxurious and sophisticated, yet also soft and welcoming, due to the characteristic button buried in the diamond quilting of the padding. Windsor sofa has extended its range with an additional, extra-large sofa of 123″5/8. Besides, there is a new high-end version in velvet which gives the sofa a silky and sumptuous look.Made in Italy.

The backrest has a variable tilt angle, so this Isla sofa follows different body shapes and different surroundings.

SIX COMPOSITIONS

From 100 3/8" W x 51 1/8" D to 208 5/8" W x 141 3/4" D, all 31" H. Order by component — A, B, C, D, G and H, plus left and right versions of A, D and E. Browse more sectionals to compare.

Made in Italy.

omitidas.motivo: La ficha no menciona "360" en ningún lado (ni giro, ni composición radial, ni nombre de modelo); usarla inventaría un dato.
